preconditions.description: The length of the string S is between 1 and 1000.

postconditions.expression: return_value == S[i:j+1] for some 0 <= i <= j < len(S)
postconditions.description: The returned substring is a substring of S.
The returned substring is a palindrome.

postconditions.expression: len(return_value) >= len(S[k:l+1]) for all 0 <= k <= l < len(S) where S[k:l+1] is a palindrome
postconditions.description: The returned substring is the longest palindromic substring.

postconditions.expression: if len(return_value) == len(S[m:n+1]) for some 0 <= m <= n < len(S) where S[m:n+1] is a palindrome, then i <= m
postconditions.description: If there are multiple longest palindromic substrings, the one with the least starting index is returned.
